# Rewind Dynamics

> Rewind Dynamics is an Indian defence-technology company headquartered in New Delhi, established on 26 January 2020. We design and develop indigenous autonomous systems — unmanned aerial (UAV), humanoid, and tactical miniature platforms — for defence and homeland-security applications. All systems are currently under active research and development; our first real-world mission test is planned for December 2026. We are actively raising investment.

## About

- Founded: 26 January 2020, New Delhi, India
- Focus: defence applications (primary), autonomous systems and robotics
- Systems (in R&D): unmanned aerial systems, humanoid systems, tactical miniature systems
- Core capabilities: autonomy, perception, edge AI, systems engineering
- Approach: simulation-first development, honest after-action assessment, human always in command
- Status: pre-revenue R&D; nothing fielded or tested yet; first mission test planned December 2026
- Positioning: indigenous ("Made in India"), aligned with national self-reliance in defence
